title: 2027 R-CCS International HPC Computational Science Internship Program
level: Doctoral students (some teams accept undergraduate or master's students)
about: RIKEN R-CCS hosts computational-science internships in Kobe, Tokyo and Wako for students at universities outside Japan, mainly doctoral students. Term 1 (start 13 April to 29 July 2027, up to 20 places) closes 1 December 2026, noon JST; Term 2 closes 8 February 2027.
requirements: Enrolled as a student at a university located outside Japan
Doctoral student specializing in computational science
Official request letter from the home institution
Term 2 (starts after 3 August 2027, up to 10 places) closes 8 February 2027, noon JST

upskill.name: AI Foundations Academy
why: field "Computational science / high-performance computing" -> course A001.19 objective "GPU computing: CUDA ecosystem; NVIDIA dominance in AI training hardware" and "Distributed training: data parallelism, model parallelism, pipeline parallelism" (A001.19 scored below course_min_score, so the post links to the AI Foundations Academy page)

card_alt: EduCut Connect card for the 2027 R-CCS International HPC Computational Science Internship Program at the RIKEN Center for Computational Science (R-CCS) in Kobe, Japan, deadline 1 Dec 2026. The photo shows the illuminated Tokyo Tower and the Tokyo skyline at dusk, not Kobe.
